cases.mission: Read case.json and audit each service against the policy. Derive whether the configuration is consistent, which services are affected, and the mismatch counts by category. Report the resulting fact=value pairs using these exact labels: config_consistent, affected_services, replica_mismatches, timeout_mismatches, logging_mismatches. Derive every value from case.json yourself.
cases.rationale: The worker has the replica mismatch; the scheduler has timeout and log-format mismatches. Two services are affected, so the audit can finish by acknowledging the inconsistency.

cases.mission: Read case.json and reconcile every ledger charge with its evidence amount. Derive the ledger total, evidence total, signed difference between them, and the affected entry. Report the resulting fact=value pairs using these exact labels: ledger_total, evidence_total, reconciliation_delta, mismatched_entry. Derive every value from case.json yourself.
cases.rationale: The ledger sums to 25 and the evidence sums to 24; charge-b is recorded as 5 in the ledger but 4 in evidence, producing a delta of 1.

cases.mission: Read case.json and compare each actual service setting with its corresponding requirement. Derive whether the configuration is consistent, which services are affected, and the mismatch counts by category. Report the resulting fact=value pairs using these exact labels: config_consistent, affected_services, region_mismatches, retention_mismatches. Derive every value from case.json yourself.
cases.rationale: Worker differs only in region and reports differs only in retention. Exactly two services are affected and there is one mismatch in each category.

cases.mission: Read case.json and reconcile invoice amounts against payments by invoice. Derive the invoice total, payment total, remaining balance, and the invoice with a short payment. Report the resulting fact=value pairs using these exact labels: invoice_total, payment_total, unpaid_balance, short_paid_invoice. Derive every value from case.json yourself.
cases.rationale: Invoices total 460 and payments total 440. Invoice-102 is short by 20 while the other two invoices are fully paid.
